title_en: The Old Man Who Moved the Mountains
summary_zh: 本页为绘本标题页，展示‘愚公移山’四个大字，下方有一个戴着斗笠的小人仰望高山，背景是连绵的山脉和蓝天白云，象征故事的开端。

title_en: The Old Man Who Moved the Mountains
page_text_ocr_zh: 北山有一位老头，名叫愚公。他见到太行山和王屋山挡在门前，出门很不方便，就产生了一个大胆的想法，愚公想把这两座山都搬走。
page_text_en: In the north mountain, there was an old man named Yu Gong. He saw the Taihang Mountains and Wangwu Mountains blocking his front door, making it very inconvenient to go out. He then came up with a bold idea: Yu Gong wanted to move both mountains away.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了愚公因太行山和王屋山阻挡出行而萌生移山的想法，画面中愚公背对读者，凝视着两座大山。

title_en: The Old Man Who Moved the Mountains
page_text_ocr_zh:
这一天，他把妻子、儿女和大大小小孙女一起喊来，商量这件事情。儿女们倒是很赞成，但是妻子说：
“老头子，你是不是老糊涂啦！这么大年纪还要搬山，再说，挖了的泥土又要往哪堆呢？ ”
page_text_en:
One day, he called his wife, children, and grandchildren, big and small, together to discuss this matter. The children were in favor, but his wife said: 
"Old man, are you going senile? At your age, you still want to move the mountains? And besides, where will you pile up the excavated soil?"
summary_zh: 愚公召集家人商议移山计划，儿女们支持，但妻子质疑其可行性，担心年纪大且无处堆放挖出的泥土。

title_en: The Old Man Who Moved the Mountains
page_text_ocr_zh:
愚公和妻子争吵起来，儿子出来劝解说：
“不要紧，我们可以把挖出来的泥土挑到渤海去。”愚公和众儿孙们齐声赞成，妻子见
大家决心已定，便不再反对。
page_text_en:
Yu Gong and his wife started arguing, and their son stepped in to mediate:
"Don't worry, we can carry the excavated soil to the Bohai Sea." Yu Gong and his descendants all agreed, and seeing that everyone was determined, the wife no longer objected.
summary_zh: 愚公与妻子因移山计划产生争执，儿子提出将挖出的泥土挑到渤海，得到全家支持，妻子最终不再反对。

title_en: The Old Man Who Moved the Mountains
page_text_ocr_zh: 带着妻子、儿孙，扛起锄头、镢头，带上簸箕上山了。
page_text_en: With his wife and children, he took up hoes and picks, carried baskets, and went up the mountain.
summary_zh: 愚公带领家人带着工具上山开始移山工作。

title_en: The Old Man Who Moved the Mountains
page_text_ocr_zh: 愚公的壮举惊动了四邻，大家纷纷前来观看，京城有一寡妇，带着孩子也奔奔跳跳来帮忙了。
page_text_en: Yu Gong's great deed stirred the neighbors, and everyone came to watch. From the capital city, a widow, accompanied by her child, came hopping and skipping to help out.
summary_zh: 愚公移山的举动吸引了邻居们前来围观，一位京城的寡妇带着孩子也前来帮忙。

title_en: The Old Man Who Moved the Mountains
page_text_ocr_zh: 就这样，愚公挖山，妻子铲土，儿孙们挑着簸箕往渤海运。一天连着一天，速度很慢，但是他们从来不灰心，每天搬山不止。
page_text_en: And so, Yu Gong dug the mountain, his wife shoveled the soil, and his descendants carried baskets to the Bohai Sea. Day after day, the progress was slow, but they never lost heart, moving the mountain every day without stopping.
summary_zh: 愚公一家齐心协力移山，愚公挖山，妻子铲土，儿孙们挑着簸箕将土运往渤海，尽管速度缓慢，但他们坚持不懈，日复一日地劳作。

title_en: The Old Man Who Moved the Mountains
page_text_ocr_zh: 河曲智叟觉得愚公太傻了，他劝他说：“我说老哥，你这么一把年纪还能搬得了这两座山吗？早早地回家歇了吧！”愚公拄着镢头说：“不用担心，我死了有儿子，儿子死了有孙子，子子孙孙没有穷尽，总有一天会搬完的。”智叟被噎得哑口无言，只好苦笑着摇摇头。
page_text_en: The wise old man from Hequ thought Yu Gong was too foolish. He advised him: "Old brother, at your age, how can you possibly move these two mountains? Go home and rest early!" Yu Gong, leaning on his hoe, replied: "Don't worry. When I die, I have my son; when my son dies, I have my grandson. Our descendants will never end. One day, we will move them all." The wise old man was left speechless, and could only smile bitterly while shaking his head.
summary_zh: 智叟嘲笑愚公年老体衰无法移山，愚公则以子子孙孙无穷尽来回应，表示移山终将成功，智叟被说服而无言以对。

title_en: The Old Man Who Moved the Mountains
page_text_ocr_zh: 一天，天神从空中路过，看到了这场景，惊得连忙赶回去禀告天帝。天帝听了之后，十分感动。他觉得愚公他们精神可嘉，于是派了两个儿子去搬掉那座大山。
page_text_en: One day, a heavenly deity passing by in the sky saw this scene and, startled, hurried back to report it to the Heavenly Emperor. After hearing the report, the Heavenly Emperor was deeply moved. He thought Yu Gong and his family's spirit was admirable, so he sent his two sons to move the mountain.
summary_zh: 天神将愚公移山的场景禀告天帝，天帝深受感动，派自己的两个儿子去搬走大山。

title_en: The Old Man Who Moved the Mountains
page_text_ocr_zh: 他们来到山前把山摇了摇，蹲下身子，一人一座，把山搬走了。
page_text_en: They came to the foot of the mountains, shook them gently, crouched down, and each carried away one mountain.
summary_zh: 天帝派两位天神来到山前，一人搬走一座大山，完成了移山的奇迹。

title_en: The Old Man Who Moved the Mountains
page_text_ocr_zh: 从此以后，愚公的家门前一片平原，道路十分好走。
page_text_en: From then on, the area in front of Yu Gong's home became a vast plain, and the road was very easy to walk on.
summary_zh: 愚公移山成功后，家门前变成一片平原，道路变得十分好走。

title_en: The Old Man Who Moved the Mountains
page_text_ocr_zh:
思考
这个寓言故事的寓意是：
它并不是真的叫我们“移山”或者“搬家”，而是
要我们学习这种坚持下去
的精神，遇到任何困难，
只要我们够执着认真，没
什么是解决不了的。
page_text_en:
Thinking
The moral of this fable is:
It is not really asking us to 'move mountains' or 'move house', but rather
for us to learn the spirit of perseverance. When facing any difficulties,
as long as we are persistent and serious, there is nothing we cannot solve.
summary_zh: 本页通过卡通狮子的思考，总结了愚公移山故事的寓意：强调坚持不懈、执着认真的精神，面对困难时只要持之以恒，就能克服一切。
